method.description: Enumerates the whole input space of a combinational cone using only the tennm_lcell_comb semantics in hal_agilex.primitives, and reads the truth table off it. Exhaustive, so the resulting table is the function, not a sample of it.

notes: Structure-bounded claims only: every finding is about what the netlist is wired to compute, never about what the design is for.
none-detected is a result, not a failure: it means none of the six passes fired, and the per-pass findings say what each one looked for.
